note: Three spoken questions on shared tab audio, one stub-then-full stream, and candidate lines that the live pass labeled THEM.

events.text: Can you tell me what an incident is?
chunks: I would want to confirm that.
An incident is an unplanned event that disrupts a service, and I record the evidence before I close it.

events.text: I can explain the incident from the alerts I watched.
I contained the host and I wrote the timeline.
What is the difference between a risk, a threat and a vulnerability?
chunks: A risk is the chance a threat exploits a vulnerability, and I separate those three words before I answer.

events.text: Can you tell me about the incident response plan?
chunks: That is not on my resume, so I will not invent it.
An incident response plan is the sequence I follow to detect, contain, and recover, and I keep each step on the record.
